text: And not to me, betrayal. Now for some of you, you have had far worse kinds of betrayal and relational pain than that. But it's one of the reasons there are so many songs in our culture about the pain of relationships. Taylor Swift and Bad Blood. Did you think we'd be fine? Still got scars on my back from your knife. So don't think it's in the past. These kinds of wounds they last and they last. The wound of betrayal, she says, it lasts and it lasts. Traitor Olivia Rodrigo.
